versions.changelog:
- Clarified "Start on APIDot" section with direct entry points for Seedance 1.5 Pro, API docs, dashboard, and examples.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to core API guidance or security advice; no executable or networking changes.

Initial release of Seedance 1.5 Pro API documentation skill.

- Provides in-depth docs and guidance for using APIDot Seedance 1.5 Pro API, covering text-to-video, image-to-video, audio sync, first/last frame, polling, webhooks, and async tasks.
- Includes security guidelines for API key handling and emphasizes using official APIDot documentation for current request fields.
- Offers clear model routing and resource links for Seedance 1.5 Pro integration.
- No executable code, scripts, network calls, or credential storage included; documentation and reference notes only.
- Suggests related APIDot skills for broader or different model families.
